name: enclosed_biomes
description: Stand-in for the Biomes! Caverns runs while that mod cannot load (its assembly binds against a Biomes! Core version Steam has since replaced). Covers Gate A on two genuinely enclosed maps — vanilla Underground and Ancient urban ruins' AM_UndergroundSpace — and proves §5's night floor stops lifting glow under rock. Gate B is not exercised: no installed biome outside Biomes! Caverns sets BiomeDef.disableShadows. Whole map roofed with thick rock so the screenshots are of a real cave.

steps._comment: Roof a 60x60 block centred on the colony with real thick rock — the same isThickRoof shape Biomes! Caverns stamps map-wide as BMT_RockRoofStable. Offset form rather than the anchor form: a first attempt used an absolute anchor copied from another scenario and silently roofed the wrong place, which the screenshots caught. Present so the frames show an actual cave; §7b's occlusion of it is unchanged by this work and is covered by indoor_sky_occlusion.json.
BASELINE — open air at midnight. §5's night floor is lifting glow off starlight, airglow and moonlight. This is the value the enclosed readings have to fall away from.

Vanilla's midnight glow is 0; everything above it is §5's night floor. Calibrated from a live run rather than borrowed — the floor includes MOONLIGHT, so it tracks this scenario's own absolute tick and the 0.1419 that weather_dimming.json pins does not transfer.
VANILLA UNDERGROUND — enclosed by the single-weather clause, and needs no third-party mod at all. Exercises Gate A only: it does not set disableShadows.
Underground does NOT set disableShadows, so Gate B stays open here. Pinned to keep the two gates visibly independent.
THE NUMERIC PROOF. §5 was lifting a night floor with MOONLIGHT on a map under rock; gated, CurSkyGlow falls back to vanilla's midnight zero.

AM_UndergroundSpace (Ancient urban ruins) — the closest available stand-in for a Biomes! Caverns cavern: a single-weather enclosed map, so it exercises Gate A exactly as BMT_EarthenDepths does (its disableShadows sits on the MapGeneratorDef, not the biome, so Gate B is untouched here). Chosen because its only dependency is Harmony, unlike Caverns which currently cannot load at all against the freshly-updated Biomes! Core.

Gate B stays OPEN here, and a live run corrected this file's first draft. The disableShadows:true in this mod sits on its MapGeneratorDef, not on the AM_UndergroundSpace BiomeDef, and Gate B reads BiomeDef.disableShadows — the same field vanilla itself tests at SectionLayer_SunShadows.Visible. NO installed biome except Biomes! Caverns' three sets that field, so Gate B has no live coverage while Caverns cannot load; it rests on MapSkyMathTests and on ApiCompatibilityTests pinning vanilla's own use of the field.
Noon in the same enclosed map — the frame where an ungated colour-temperature or twilight shift would be most visible.
Dusk, the worst case for §2's warm twilight nudge.
Same tick, open air, for the A/B.

args.prompt: Both images are the same roofed colony at the same dusk hour; only the biome differs. The FIRST is an enclosed underground map, the SECOND is open air. The SECOND should show a warm orange/amber sunset cast. The FIRST must NOT: an enclosed map has no sky, so it should show no sunset warmth at all. PASS if only the second image carries a warm sunset cast. FAIL if the first is also tinted warm, which would mean a sky effect is still being applied under a rock ceiling. Ignore terrain, rock and plant differences between biomes.
